metadata.description: Agent Plugins marketplace: ixiongdi workflows, Zvec, engine tooling for Unity/Unreal/Godot/Blender, and design and geospatial tooling for pen.dev and Cesium.

plugins.name: ixiongdi
plugins.description: Skills (V-model, Clean Code, optimize-prompt, ID algorithms) plus id-generator MCP.

plugins.name: zvec
plugins.description: Zvec vector database: skill plus official MCP via uvx. Upstream sources are not vendored.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity Editor agent tooling, CLI-first: the Unity CLI's own MCP server (unity mcp) plus a skill covering the CLI, the Pipeline package, and Unity's first-party skills.

plugins.name: unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine 5.8 official MCP (ModelContextProtocol plugin) over HTTP, plus Epic's first-party skill routes.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Godot 4 agent tooling. No official MCP exists, so skills only: maps the community options with client configs.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Blender's official MCP server from Blender Lab, launched via uv, with a skill for the add-on and tool set.

plugins.name: pencil
plugins.description: pen.dev design canvas, registered under its MCP server name pencil. Skills only: pen.dev writes its own MCP client config, so this documents the connection and workflow.

plugins.name: cesium
plugins.description: CesiumJS 3D globe control via the community MCP runtime, plus a skill covering the required browser half and Cesium's own official MCP and skills repo.
